verdict.rationale: Billing anchors and cycles are a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only one-time invoice creation, templates, reminders, credit notes and taxes. Nothing covers billing cycle anchors, calendar versus anniversary billing, aligning a customer's subscriptions, or setting custom invoice dates.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates
